text: Fresh post-indexing audit: full Float/Double sums still route every element through foreachLogical, which allocates rank counters and executes the general carry machine even for contiguous and coalesced rank-one layouts. Axis sums already use direct fibers, but foreachAxisBase walks one fiber at a time; axis 0 therefore needs output-fiber tiling for cache locality while preserving each fiber addition order. Planned safe sequence: add exact-schedule contiguous/rank1/rank2 full-sum loops first; add tiled rank-two axis0 and direct rank-two axis1 sum loops second; retain general fallbacks and the 128-element block/merge order; add adversarial bit-differential cases before benchmarking. No reduction source edit has been made because the next sbt escalation was rejected when the approval reviewer reported its usage limit.
